question: Using a recursive monthly inventory adjustment model starting from December 2018 inventory levels, where we restock a product if its ending inventory drops below the minimum required level, determine for each product the month in 2019 where the absolute difference between its ending inventory and the minimum required level is the smallest, and return the product_id, that month, and the absolute difference.
sql:
-- Verify the differences for product 6600
WITH RECURSIVE months AS (
    SELECT DATE '2019-01-01' as mth
    UNION ALL
    SELECT mth + INTERVAL '1' MONTH
    FROM months
    WHERE mth < DATE '2019-12-01'
),
product_min AS (
    SELECT product_id, qty_minimum, qty_purchase
    FROM product_minimums
),
start_inv AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as inventory
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY product_id
),
inv_model(product_id, mth, ending_inv, restocked) AS (
    SELECT si.product_id, m.mth, 
           si.inventory - COALESCE(ms.qty, 0),
           CASE WHEN (si.inventory - COALESCE(ms.qty, 0)) < pm.qty_minimum THEN pm.qty_purchase ELSE 0 END
    FROM start_inv si
    JOIN months m ON m.mth = DATE '2019-01-01'
    JOIN product_min pm ON pm.product_id = si.product_id
    LEFT JOIN monthly_sales ms ON ms.product_id = si.product_id 
        AND CAST('2018-' || EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m.mth)::VARCHAR || '-01' AS DATE) = CAST(ms.mth AS DATE)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT im.product_id, m.mth,
           im.ending_inv + im.restocked - COALESCE(ms.qty, 0),
           CASE WHEN (im.ending_inv + im.restocked - COALESCE(ms.qty, 0)) < pm.qty_minimum THEN pm.qty_purchase ELSE 0 END
    FROM inv_model im
    JOIN months m ON m.mth = im.mth + INTERVAL '1' MONTH
    JOIN product_min pm ON pm.product_id = im.product_id
    LEFT JOIN monthly_sales ms ON ms.product_id = im.product_id 
        AND CAST('2018-' || EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m.mth)::VARCHAR || '-01' AS DATE) = CAST(ms.mth AS DATE)
    WHERE m.mth <= DATE '2019-12-01'
)
SELECT product_id, mth, ending_inv, ABS(ending_inv - 30) as abs_diff
FROM inv_model
WHERE product_id = 6600
ORDER BY mth
